description: Estimated aerodynamic and mass package for a conventional wing-and-aft-tail electric trainer without landing gear. Geometry comes from the player; closed forms are evaluated by app/workshop/creator/packages.gd; the constants below are borrowed from the donor record or estimated. Software estimate only: no real-aircraft calibration. Derivation: docs/research/aircraft-creator/estimated-trainer-package.md.

donor.note: Rectangular AR 5 Stik carrying the OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e nondimensional coefficient set. Dihedral 2.86 deg per panel, estimated from the plan's 1.5 in tip rise (docs/research/flight-dynamics/stik-roll-sideslip-2026-10-19).

zero_alpha_lift.source: Donor aero.coefficients.CL0 (OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e), used as the wing's lift at zero body angle of attack: lightly cambered trainer section with its chord line on the body x axis

section_moment.source: Donor aero.coefficients.Cm0 (OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e), used as the wing section moment about its aerodynamic centre; its size matches the zero-alpha lift for a lightly cambered section

downwash_factor.source: Donor downwash gradient 0.457 (flat-wing vortex lattice, AR 5, docs/research/roadmap-investigations/02-aerodynamics-rc-scale.md T2) divided by the far-wake estimate 2·Helmbold(5)/(π·5) = 0.5416; one calibration point, valid near the donor's tail arm of 2.4 chords

oswald_efficiency.source: 1/(π·AR·k) with the donor's k_induced 0.0814934 at AR 5 (OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e)

profile_drag.source: Donor aero.coefficients.CD0 (OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e whole-aircraft zero-lift drag of a stick-type sport model); the donor value includes a fixed gear the candidate lacks

dihedral_factor.source: Share of the strip-theory dihedral effect −a_w·Γ/4 that the induced flow of an antisymmetric loading leaves: the donor wing's lifting-line slope −0.01335 per rad of sideslip per degree of dihedral (D10-R5, docs/research/flight-dynamics/stik-roll-sideslip-2026-10-19 section 3, through the runtime's induced map) divided by Helmbold(5)/4·(π/180) = 0.018561; one calibration point, AR 5 rectangular. Lifting-line theory for an elliptic wing gives (AR + 2)/(AR + 4) = 0.78 at AR 5 for the same share

roll_damping_reference.source: Donor aero.coefficients.Clp (OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e) at AR 5, taper 1

cruise_lift.source: Lift coefficient of the donor at its 15 m/s level start: 2·2.885 kg·g/(1.225 kg/m3·0.464515 m2·(15 m/s)²) = 0.442

efficiency.source: Tail dynamic-pressure ratio η of the donor's horizontal-tail estimate (donor aero.surfaces.horizontal.downwash_gradient source: Helmbold tail with η 0.9)

elevator_effectiveness.source: Plain-flap effectiveness of the elevator relative to the tail's free lift slope. The donor's Cmde −0.8488 over its tail term a_free·(S_h/S)·(l_h/c) = 1.566 gives 0.54; thin-airfoil theory for a 35-40 % chord flap gives 0.7 before viscous losses. The definition carries no hinge-line position

fin_aspect_ratio_factor.source: Reflection-plane assumption: the fuselage acts as a wall under the fin, effective aspect ratio = 2·height²/area. With it the donor fin (0.22 m × 0.22 m) gets 0.9·Helmbold(2) = 2.34/rad against the donor's provisional 2.4/rad

geometric_incidence.source: Horizontal tail chord parallel to the wing chord line; the tail's effective incidence then comes only from the wing's zero-alpha downwash

side_force.source: Donor CYb −0.4889 minus the donor's own fin term −a_v·S_v/S = −0.2501: side force of a slab-sided stick fuselage and wing, not rescaled with the player's fuselage

dihedral_effect.source: Donor Clb −0.0545 minus the donor's own fin term −0.0008: the donor's wing-body term at its own 2.86 deg of dihedral. D10-R5 (docs/research/flight-dynamics/stik-roll-sideslip-2026-10-19) attributes −0.0382 of it to geometric dihedral and −0.0155 to high-wing interference (DATCOM). The player's wing dihedral moves the dihedral share (packages.gd dihedral_effect); the interference share is not rescaled with the player's fuselage or wing height

Clda_right.source: Donor record, OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e: strip ailerons on a rectangular AR 5 wing; the definition carries no aileron geometry

Clda_left.source: Donor record, OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e: strip ailerons on a rectangular AR 5 wing; the definition carries no aileron geometry

CL_max.source: Donor aero.envelope.CL_max (estimated there: semi-symmetric section near Re 3e5)

flat_plate_base.source: Viterna CDmax = 1.11 + 0.018·AR (NASA CR-1983), as the donor's CD90

flat_plate_per_aspect_ratio.source: Viterna CDmax = 1.11 + 0.018·AR (NASA CR-1983), as the donor's CD90

inertia_reference.source: UltraStick25e Jxx Jyy Jzz (1.959 kg, 1.27 m span), the loader's inertia plausibility reference; compared after scaling by m·b²

wing_areal_density.source: Donor built-up covered wing: 0.52 kg over 0.4645 m2

tail_areal_density.source: Donor stabilizer and fin: 0.155 kg over 0.144 m2

fuselage_shell_density.source: Donor balsa/ply fuselage: 0.36 kg over the shell area 2·(width + height)·length of its two inventory boxes, 0.406 m2

fuselage_taper_factor.source: Share of the bounding-box shell a fuselage that tapers toward the tail actually has

fuselage_centroid_fraction.source: Centre of mass of a fuselage shell with a heavier front section, as a fraction of its length from the nose

wing_centroid_chord_fraction.source: Donor wing item: centroid near 40 % chord

wing_thickness_ratio.source: Typical trainer section thickness, for the wing item's box height only

servo_mass.source: Standard analog servo, as the donor's servo items

receiver_mass.source: Typical 6-8 channel receiver, as the donor's receiver item

hardware_mass.source: Pushrods, horns, clevises and harness, as the donor's hardware item

wing_span_m.reason: Chord Reynolds numbers of the borrowed drag and stall data (donor span 1.52 m, UltraStick25e 1.27 m)

aspect_ratio.reason: Borrowed roll, yaw and aileron derivatives and the single downwash calibration point belong to an AR 5 wing

taper_ratio.reason: Borrowed aileron and roll data are for a rectangular wing; mild straight taper only

wing_dihedral_deg.reason: The dihedral relation is a small-angle strip estimate calibrated at the donor's 2.86 deg; it neglects the side force and yawing moment of order dihedral squared (about 12 % of CYb at 8 deg). Anhedral and polyhedral wings are not described, and the borrowed interference term belongs to a shoulder wing

mass_kg.reason: Around the donor (2.9 kg) and the UltraStick25e (2.0 kg); also the record's plausibility mass range

wing_loading_kg_m2.reason: Donor 6.2 kg/m2; keeps the derived level speed between 10 and 17 m/s

tail_aspect_ratio.reason: Helmbold tail slope with the donor's efficiency factor (donor 3.3)

tail_volume_h.reason: Donor 0.49; the downwash calibration and the neglected fuselage term assume a conventional tail

tail_volume_v.reason: Donor 0.051; the fuselage's destabilizing yaw is neglected

static_margin.reason: The fuselage and propeller move the real neutral point forward by a few percent of chord, which the model neglects: 8 % keeps a positive real margin; above 30 % the elevator trim leaves the model's small-angle region

thrust_to_weight.reason: Hand launch needs a clear thrust surplus; above 2 the aircraft can hang on the propeller, where the model has no propeller wash on the tail

hub_ahead_of_nose_m.reason: Tractor propeller disc ahead of the fuselage nose, with the motor still attached to it

aileron_travel_deg.reason: The borrowed aileron derivatives are linear per radian (donor 20 deg); beyond about 30 deg a real surface separates and the linear model overstates roll power

elevator_travel_deg.reason: The borrowed elevator derivative is linear per radian (donor 20 deg); larger travel drives the model far outside its attached-flow region

rudder_travel_deg.reason: The fin-derived rudder derivative is linear per radian (donor 25 deg)

servo_time_s.reason: Neutral-to-full times of ordinary RC servos on these throws (donor 0.14 s); faster than 0.05 s is not hardware this package describes

down_thrust_deg.reason: Thrust-line trim angles of a conventional tractor installation; larger angles are a different installation, with propeller normal force the model neglects

right_thrust_deg.reason: Thrust-line trim angles of a conventional tractor installation

initial_charge.reason: A flight started below about 20 % charge sags to the bottom of the borrowed two-point voltage curve within seconds; the start checks assume usable power
